name: Westbound Panama Canal Spiced Chicken Liver Mousse with Baguette & Caramelized Pears
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Westbound Panama Canal (Panama Canal Menu)
whyItWorks: Silky whipped chicken liver mousse served with peeled caramelized pears and white baguette slices—zero seeds or raw roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy a modest smear of the smooth mousse and peeled caramelized pear over soft baguette bread.
watchOuts: Rich butter/cream fat in the liver mousse
